linear.label: Linear OLS
linear.call: stats::lm(formula = gd ~ x_scaled, data = data, tol = 1e-10)
linear.fit_definition:
function (data) 
stats::lm(gd ~ x_scaled, data = data, tol = 1e-10)

quadratic.label: Quadratic (degree 2)
quadratic.call: stats::lm(formula = gd ~ x_scaled + I(x_scaled^2), data = data,      tol = 1e-10)
quadratic.fit_definition:
function (data) 
stats::lm(gd ~ x_scaled + I(x_scaled^2), data = data, tol = 1e-10)
